Subject: Post-demo: signal alignment & tuning plan for reranker integration

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Great to see the search use case and the example queries from the catalog team. Quick recap + a compact list of technical questions so our engineers can start scoping the POC: 

Recap (super short)
- NovaCorp wants to add a reranker after their retrieval stage to improve precision in top-5 results for product search.
- Primary signals: textual relevance + recency + click-priority weights.
- Success target: +8–12% lift in relevance for hand-labeled test set; strong latency behavior under 200ms p95 for rerank-only calls.

Immediate asks for the engineering scoping
1) SDK & endpoints: do you prefer using our REST API or the Redwood SDK (Python/Node) for the POC? Any firewall/IP allowlist constraints we should know?
2) Auth model: will you use SAML SSO + service accounts, or JWT/API keys managed by your infra team? Any short-lived token requirements?
3) Routing & batching: what QPS should we emulate for the pilot (peak/steady)? We can configure batching and prefix caching if you expect bursts.
4) Structured output / tool calling: will the reranker need to return structured signals (confidence, matched-entities) or just scores? Any downstream orchestrator that expects a specific JSON shape?
5) Embeddings & index: do you plan to use your current vector store (Milvus) or Redwood embeddings + our index adapters?
6) Evaluation metrics & top_k tuning: what metrics are you tracking today (MAP@k, Recall@k, NDCG)? Can you share a small labeled set (CSV fine) so we can run an initial baseline?

We can propose a mutual action plan once we know answers above. If helpful, I can loop in Marissa (technical PM) and Vanessa (AE) to book a 60-min tech workshop.

Attachments: none in this message — please see next message for SSO doc Alex mentioned.

Next steps I propose:
- You send a redacted sample labeled set (<= 500 rows) and confirm auth approach
- We run an initial baseline (Redwood rerank vs. current ranker) and return MAP@5, NDCG@5 and latency distribution
- Tech workshop with engineers (deep dive into SDK snippet + auth)

Thanks,
Sergio

Sergio — thanks, good recap. A few quick answers inline and I attached our SSO integration note (stub):

1) SDK & endpoints: we prefer HTTP/REST for the POC (our infra team standardizes on service endpoints). No restrictive IP allowlist but we do run through an outbound proxy; will share proxy host.

2) Auth model: we'll use SAML-backed SSO for human users but the reranker will be called server-to-server. We prefer short-lived JWTs minted by our identity service (rotation every 12 hours) rather than static API keys. Can Redwood support token introspection endpoint or OIDC/JWT validation? (See attached: novacorp-sso-integration.pdf)

3) Routing & batching: expected steady QPS for the pilot ~30 r/s, peak bursts to 120 r/s for seasonal events. P95 latency target for the integrated call (retrieve + rerank) is 350ms; we understand rerank-only will be lower.

4) Structured output/tool-calling: we expect the reranker to return score + optional matched_entity list and reasoning string. Downstream orchestration will accept a JSON object {id, score, signals: []}.

5) Embeddings & index: we plan to continue using Milvus but are open to Redwood embeddings if there's a measurable lift. We can share index schema.

6) Evaluation metrics & top_k: current metrics are Precision@5, MAP@5, and NDCG@5. We'll provide a labeled CSV (sample attached next).

Proposed meeting: Fri 24 Jul 2026 11:00am PT for a 60-min tech workshop (engineers: Matt Perez, myself). If that works I'll send an invite and attach the sample CSV + SSO doc.

Regards,

Alex / team — thanks for confirming. I'm attaching the evaluation template (rerank-eval-template.csv) and dropping a compact tech checklist below so engineers can prepare for the Fri workshop.

Technical checklist (for the workshop)
- Auth & tokens:
  - Redwood supports JWT validation (RS256) against your OIDC issuer; we also support introspection endpoints. For short-lived tokens we recommend mutual TLS between our infra and your token service when possible.
  - For server-to-server calls, provide a service account (name + OIDC issuer URL) and a sample token exchange flow.

- SDK / snippet: (Python pseudocode)
  - Client init: RedwoodClient(api_url="https://api.redwood.com", auth_method="jwt", token_provider=...)
  - Rerank call: client.rerank(model="rdw-rerank-v1", items=[{id,text,meta}], top_k=5, return_signals=true)

- Endpoints & payload shape:
  - Expect POST /v1/rerank with body {query: string, candidates: [{id,text,meta}], top_k: int, return_signals: bool}
  - Response: {results: [{id, score, signals:[{name,value}], reasoning?}], metrics?: {processing_ms}}

- Batching & latency: we will show recommended batch sizes for the pilot (1—8 candidate batches) and warmup steps to populate KV cache for prefix-heavy queries.

- Top_k tuning & metrics to run during baseline:
  - MAP@1, MAP@3, MAP@5; NDCG@1, NDCG@3, NDCG@5; Recall@k; as well as latency p50/p95.
  - Run sweep across top_k = [3,5,10] and a simple re-weighting grid for click-priority vs recency signals.

- Structured output considerations:
  - If you want downstream tools to consume signals, we'll include a compact signals array and a stable JSON schema version. If you need tool-calling (e.g., an external enrichment service called when reasoning triggers), we'll show sample webhooks.

Attachments: rerank-eval-template.csv (attachment stub)

- 10–40m: API/SDK deep dive (Marissa)

I'll bring a small checklist and an example payload so your infra team can sanity-check the exchange. Looking forward to it.
